1.consolidated_definition: "Guineo": fruto del árbol de guanábana (Annona muricata), caracterizado por su pulpa blanca y jugosa rodeada de una cubierta verde espinosa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Guineo: fruit of the soursop tree (Annona muricata), characterized by its white and juicy pulp surrounded by a green spiny husk.
